comparison.objective: Use a scoop to put clean ice into a bowl.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid removal, clean-source selection, scoop pickup and controlled delivery.
comparison.success_condition: One clean cube delivered by the scoop after lid opening, without contamination or fish-bin ice, sustained 1 s.
comparison.reason: Despite shared loose-body handling, the tested ability is hygienic source selection with a scoop, not physical sieve separation.
